title: Broker's email: New workers' compensation submission
summary: Cover email from Prairie State Insurance Agency submitting workers' compensation for Lakeshore Dental Group, a three office Chicago dental practice, effective Dec 1, 2026. It gives headline figures, notes a fourth office opening in January 2027, and asks for a quote by Oct 20 at or under the expiring $31,400 premium.
problems: The payroll and employee count exclude about six hires for the Lincoln Park office opening January 2027, so exposure will grow midterm.
The email does not say whether there is a written safety program, return-to-work program or drug-free workplace.

title: Workers' compensation application

problems: The drug-free workplace question has neither Yes nor No checked.
The applicant statement is not signed, and the name, title and date are blank.
No deductible is given since guaranteed cost was chosen.
